criteria.name: Source fidelity
criteria.note: Every receipt has a statutory section, official source pointer, excerpt, and explicit limit.

criteria.name: Claim-to-receipt traceability
criteria.note: Every public paragraph names the receipts that support it.

criteria.name: Human translation
criteria.note: The long piece is readable rather than exhaustive, and the 30-second version is genuinely short.

criteria.name: Semantic precision
criteria.note: The essay distinguishes loan principal from appropriated cash and distinguishes grants from tax credits.

criteria.name: Synthesis
criteria.note: The column finds one thesis across money, conditions, industrial capacity, and science rather than listing sections.

criteria.name: Restraint and uncertainty
criteria.note: The public story separates enacted mechanics from later wisdom, success, motive, and outcomes.
